'''Unit 17''' was a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Confederacy engaged the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] in a [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|battle]] for the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]. Unit 17 participated in the battle, serving under the Confederate [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="ISotR3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Unit 17's only appearance was in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]] written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]].
